name: Caprock Mining Corp.
summary: Caprock Mining Corp. is an enterprise dedicated to the identification and assessment of mineral deposits. This Canadian firm focuses its prospecting efforts on gold and various other valuable metals. The company is currently finalizing the acquisition of a complete (100%) ownership stake in several key properties located within Ontario: Mud Lake, Golden Heart, Brookbank East, Three Towers, Miner Lake, and Green Oaks. Founded in 2020, Caprock Mining Corp. maintains its primary operations from Toronto, Canada. It previously conducted business as Blingold Corp. before rebranding to Caprock Mining Corp. in July 2021.
